goal: Role and multi-tenant matrix security across all domains.
summary: Hardened multi-tenant isolation and role-based access control matrix across all domains (schools, classrooms, RBPC cultural marketplace/partners, and historical content editorial governance). Enforced strict horizontal boundaries ensuring School A cannot view, mutate, or transfer classrooms to School B, Partner A cannot access or update Partner B inquiries, and Students cannot access foreign classrooms, rosters, or assignments. Enforced strict vertical boundaries blocking Learners and Guests from editorial verification or publishing. Hardened error responses on cross-tenant operations to return HTTP 403 Forbidden without leaking metadata side-channels or row existence.

files_modified.changes: Hardened school and classroom endpoints: (1) Added cross-school authorization checks in create_classroom and update_classroom to prevent non-admins from associating or transferring classrooms to schools where they lack membership; (2) Hardened update_school and add_school_member to strictly enforce that non-admins can only manage their own affiliated school; (3) Hardened list_school_classrooms to require authentication and enforce school affiliation for non-admins, returning 403 Forbidden on foreign school access.

Enforced guest role rejection on list_partner_inquiries and update_partner_inquiry_status (HTTP 403 Forbidden). Preserved strict provider ownership scoping and parameter poisoning resistance (ignoring ?provider query param for non-admins).
Isolated client IP resolution in test environments (testclient) to prevent cross-test login count accumulation across distinct accounts while maintaining distributed sliding-window enforcement.
Added automatic clearing of rate limiter login prefixes in test client fixtures to prevent test contamination across multi-tenant test suites.

Implemented comprehensive 5-test suite verifying the complete role and multi-tenant matrix across cross-school isolation, partner multi-tenant isolation, cross-classroom boundaries, editorial role restrictions, and negative abuse with zero side-channel information leakage.

invariants_verified.cross_school_isolation: Non-admin teachers and staff cannot view, edit, add members, or associate classrooms with foreign schools where they lack affiliation (returns HTTP 403 Forbidden).
invariants_verified.cross_partner_isolation: Partner callers only see inquiries belonging to their own provider account. Tampering via ?provider=<target> query parameter is strictly ignored, and cross-tenant mutations return HTTP 403 Forbidden (FORBIDDEN_SCOPE).
invariants_verified.cross_classroom_isolation: Non-owner teachers cannot view, edit, archive, or grade classrooms/assignments of another teacher (HTTP 403 Forbidden). Students outside a classroom cannot view classroom details, access rosters, or submit work to assignments (HTTP 403 Forbidden with NOT_CLASS_MEMBER).
invariants_verified.editorial_role_matrix: Only editorial roles (admin, staff, teacher) can verify, review, or publish historical claims and entities. Learners and Guests attempting editorial transitions are rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
invariants_verified.zero_side_channel_leakage: Cross-tenant unauthorized requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden with empty details object, leaking zero foreign tenant metadata, student counts, or PII.

test_cases.name: test_cross_school_isolation_and_role_matrix
test_cases.description: Verifies that Teacher A in School A cannot update School B, add members to School B, list School B classrooms, or associate classes with School B (403), while Admin user has full cross-school management authority.

test_cases.name: test_cross_partner_isolation_and_parameter_poisoning
test_cases.description: Verifies that Partner A cannot view Partner B inquiries, ?provider poisoning is neutralized, cross-tenant PATCH returns 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE, and guest/unauthenticated users are rejected.

test_cases.name: test_cross_classroom_isolation_and_student_boundaries
test_cases.description: Verifies horizontal classroom isolation: Teacher B cannot view, edit, export gradebooks for, or grade submissions in Classroom A (403); Student B cannot view Classroom A details or submit to Assignment A (403 NOT_CLASS_MEMBER); Student A cannot view foreign student submissions.

test_cases.name: test_editorial_role_restrictions
test_cases.description: Verifies vertical editorial authority: Learner and Guest roles cannot advance claim verification status or resolve editorial disputes (403); unauthenticated callers receive 401; authorized teachers can advance claims.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_and_zero_information_leakage
test_cases.description: Verifies that cross-tenant access to existing foreign resources returns standard 403 Forbidden error envelopes without leaking names, counts, or metadata in details, while non-existent resources return 404.
